member.summary:
Stores signed multipliers linking a program to analysis channels. One ValueSet per program — consumed by AnalysisStack for voxel scoring.
Multiplier rules: +1.0 = prefer HIGH values in this channel -1.0 = prefer LOW values in this channel 0.0 = ignore this channel for this program 2.0 = prefer HIGH, twice as important as 1.0

member.name: T:SpatialMorphology.VoxelScoringEngine
member.summary: Pure scoring and assignment logic extracted from AnalysisStackComponent. No Rhino, no Grasshopper, no System.Drawing — fully unit-testable.

remarks.para: This is a faithful extraction, not a redesign. Normalisation, multiplier semantics, all three assignment methods, ranking order and the alpha ramp reproduce the original component exactly, so existing definitions produce identical results.

Missing-channel default. A channel absent from a program's ValueSet is treated as multiplier 1.0 (counts fully, prefer high) — matching the original component. Note that ValueSet.GetWeight returns 0.0 (ignore) for the same case. The component never called that accessor, so the two rules never met. The component's behaviour is authoritative here because it is what saved .gh files already produce. Do not "fix" this by routing through GetWeight without a deliberate migration.

member.summary: Scores every voxel for every program and assigns each voxel to one program.
member.param: Number of voxels. Every channel must have this many values.
Analysis channels. Labels must be unique.

True = ignore each program's VoxelCount cap. False = stop assigning to a program once its cap is reached.
Optional voxel indices reserved for the core. Marked -2 and excluded from program assignment. May be null.

member.name: M:SpatialMorphology.VoxelScoringEngine.IsUnusable(System.Double)
member.summary: Matches the original sanitisation: NaN and +Infinity become 0.0.
member.remarks: NegativeInfinity is deliberately NOT filtered, reproducing the original behaviour. It would propagate into normalisation and produce NaN scores. Left as-is so this extraction changes no results; fix it as its own commit with a test, not silently here.
